turns.user: Find me the latest new about Brad Pitt
turns.assistant_text:
The latest news regarding Brad Pitt focuses on ongoing family tensions and his upcoming film projects:

**Family Challenges**
*   **Children Dropping His Surname:** There is significant coverage regarding his children's efforts to distance themselves from him. Most recently, his youngest daughter, **Vivienne**, filed a petition to legally change her name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie shortly after turning 18 [1, 3, 4]. This follows similar moves by other children, including Shiloh [2].
*   **Estrangement:** Reports indicate that Pitt has "virtually no contact" with his adult children and is reportedly upset by their decisions [2, 4].
*   **Recent Sightings:** Pitt was recently spotted relaxing at a bar in Carmel Highlands (Bud’s at the La Playa Hotel) amid these family developments [1, 3].

**Upcoming Projects**
Pitt has several films and productions on the horizon:
*   ***Heart of the Beast***: A survival thriller where he stars and produces, scheduled for release on September 25 [1].
*   ***The Adventures of Cliff Booth***: A follow-up to *Once Upon a Time in Hollywood*, releasing November 25 [1].
*   **Other Projects**: He is also associated with *The Rider*, and is producing *The Chaperones* and *Isle of Man* [3]. He recently appeared in the film *F1* as Sonny Hayes [3].

**Sources:**
[1] [mercurynews.com](https://www.mercurynews.com/2026/07/27/brad-pitt-spotted-in-famed-carmel-bar-amid-family-challenges)
[2] [brit.co](https://www.brit.co/angelina-jolie-brad-pitt-children)
[3] [timesofindia.indiatimes.com](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/english/hollywood/news/brad-pitt-spotted-at-a-bar-in-carmel-highlands-following-vivienne-jolie-pitts-name-change-request/articleshow/132677873.cms)
[4] [thedailybeast.com](https://www.thedailybeast.com/obsessed/brad-pitts-youngest-daughter-vivienne-delivers-him-fresh-insult)

items.title: Brad Pitt spotted in famed Carmel bar amid family challenges
items.summary:
But Pitt’s personal issues with his children are not likely to go away. Last week, news came that his youngest daughter, 18-year-old Vivienne, had filed a petition in Los Angeles County Superior Court, requesting that her legal name be changed from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie. Vivienne filed her petition shortly after she turned 18, and she is the latest of Pitt’s six children to separate herself from the Academy Award winner in such a public, legal way. [...] By Martha Ross | mross@bayareanewsgroup.com | Bay Area News Group

PUBLISHED: | UPDATED:

Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...

Brad Pitt has a big fall coming with the release of two new films, including “The Adventures of Cliff Booth,” but he’s also had a tumultuous summer, with news that three of his children with ex-wife Angelina Jolie have recently taken legal steps to drop his “Pitt” surname from their own names. [...] The 62-year-old actor probably would appreciate getting some “space” right now. Yes, he can look forward to promoting “Heart of the Beast,” a survival thriller film due to be released Sept. 25, for which he is the star and producer. Then, on Nov. 25, comes David Fincher’s highly anticipated follow-up to Quentin Tarantino’s hit 2019 film, “Once Upon a Time In Hollywood,” for which Pitt won his best supporting actor Oscar. Pitt returns to play cool, resourceful stuntman Cliff Booth.

items.title: The Latest News on Angelina Jolie & Brad Pitt's Children - Brit + Co
items.summary: Pitt has dropped sources and quotes over the last few years hinting at how he feels isolated from his children, and their decision to remain estranged. People recently reported that a source very close to Brad says, “He’s aware and upset that Shiloh dropped his last name." The source continued, "The reminders that he’s lost his children, is of course not easy for Brad. He loves his children and misses them. It’s very sad." [...] After news broke of Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's daughter, Shiloh, changing her last name from "Shiloh Jolie-Pitt" to "Shiloh Jolie," the whole world is wondering just what happened between this superstar family. Almost 10 years after Jolie and Pitt's divorce, it seems like the pair's children continue to draw a clear line in the sand, choosing to only remain close to their mother, and distance themselves even further from their dad. [...] After Jolie abruptly filed for divorce from her husband, news started circulating that an incident might've happened on a plane between Jolie and Pitt in front of her children. In an FBI report given to CNN, Jolie accused Pitt of "injuring her and verbally abusing their children during a heated encounter aboard a private jet in 2016."

items.title: Brad Pitt spotted at a bar in Carmel Highlands following Vivienne Jolie-Pitt’s name change request﻿ | - The Times of India
items.summary:
Brad Pitt was recently spotted at a bar in Carmel Highlands, following the news that his youngest daughter, Vivienne, is taking steps to legally change her last name. Deux Moi shared the news online of the actor relaxing at Bud’s, which is located in La Playa Hotel in Carmel-by-the-Sea.

Watch

Brad Pitt Gets BRUTALLY Honest About Hitting Rock Bottom After Jolie Split [...] Brad Pitt, who has recently been in the news after all of his children with Angelina Jolie dropped his last name. Amid the ongoing controversy and the fourth Jolie-Pitt sibling, Vivienne, going to court to change her name officially, the ‘F1’ actor was recently spotted relaxing at a bar in Carmel Highlands.

## Brad Pitt spotted relaxing in a bar [...] Brad Pitt currently has some projects lined up for release. He is set to appear in ‘Heart of the Beast’, ‘The Adventures of Cliff Booth’, and ‘The Rider’, while he is working on ‘The Chaperones’ and ‘Isle of Man’ as the producer. The actor last appeared in front of the camera in ‘F1’, where he played the role of Sonny Hayes, a retired F1 driver who returns to the scene to train an unruly and new driver who has the potential to become the number 1 race car driver.

items.title: Brad Pitt’s Youngest Daughter Vivienne Delivers Him Fresh Insult
items.summary:
Vivienne previously teased a name change in May 2024. The young actress appeared in the playbill for Broadway’s rendition of The Outsiders as “Vivienne Jolie.” She acted in the play and produced it alongside her mother.

The news comes after a summer of the Jolie-Pitt kids taking official steps to distance themselves from Pitt.

Brad Pitt breaks his silence on messy split with Angelina Jolie.

Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie had a messy, years-long divorce. Gareth Cattermole/Getty Images [...] Vivienne has now followed suit, filing her petition eight days after her 18th birthday. Only Pax and Knox (Vivienne’s twin brother) continue to use “Pitt” as their legal names.

Pitt reportedly has “virtually no contact” with his adult children, People reported in 2024. At the time, a source told the publication that the Fight Club star continues to have visitation with his younger children.

Brad Pitt, Knox Jolie-Pitt and Vivienne Jolie-Pitt are seen on July 30, 2013, in Tokyo, Japan. [...] Meera Navlakha

After news of Maddox’s name change broke, a source told the Daily Beast, “It’s not a surprise this news was released shortly after Brad had a significant evidentiary victory in the Miraval case,” referring to Jolie and Pitt’s continued dispute over the winery they jointly purchased in Provence, France.

A source close to Pitt previously told People, “It’s sad to see someone repeatedly publicize their successful alienation of their children from the other parent.”

items.title: Exclusive | How Angelina Jolie feels about her children filing to drop estranged dad Brad Pitt's last name
items.summary:
Vivienne’s filing marks the latest development in the long family rift that has unfolded since Pitt and Jolie’s highly publicized split in 2016.

The “Fight Club” star, 62, and the “Maleficent” actress, 51, finalized their divorce in December 2024, ending more than eight years of legal proceedings after Jolie filed to dissolve their marriage in September 2016.

The former couple have six children: Maddox, 24, Pax, 22, Zahara, 21, Shiloh, 20, and twins Knox and Vivienne.
